source_documents.title: Molecular packing-controlled mechanical-induced emission enhancement of tetraphenylethene functionalized pyrazoline derivatives

reference_evidence_units.quote: the enhanced emission was induced by the RIR and RIV.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-pyrazolines
reference_evidence_units.statement: AIE from restricted rotation and vibration of the TPE phenyls.

reference_evidence_units.quote: While, TPECN formed incompact J-aggregates with weak intermolecular interactions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPECN

reference_evidence_units.quote: The conformational planarization and increased intermolecular interactions induced by grinding led to the peak red-shifted and intensity slightly reduced.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPECN
reference_evidence_units.statement: More intermolecular interaction after grinding lowers emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: just slightly reduced (from 53.91% to 47.91%) after grinding.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPECN

reference_evidence_units.quote: the LUMOs were localized on TPE and cyano group.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPECN
